questions.stem: Which of the following lists the EM spectrum in order of increasing frequency?

options.text: Radio, microwaves, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma rays
Gamma rays, ultraviolet, X-rays, visible, infrared, radio, microwaves
Gamma rays, X-rays, ultraviolet, visible, infrared, microwaves, radio
Radio, infrared, microwaves, visible, ultraviolet, gamma rays, X-rays

questions.explanation: The EM spectrum in order of increasing frequency (and decreasing wavelength) is: radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma rays.
